name: mediscan-fullstack
description: MEDISCAN - Full-Stack Medicine Information Scanner Web Application (MERN)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix React install
scripts.build: npm --prefix React install && npm --prefix React run build
scripts.dev: npx --prefix React concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix Backend run dev" "npm --prefix React run dev"
